customManagers.description: Version ARGs in services/caddy-poc/Dockerfile carry a '# renovate:' comment. Base image digests are not bumped by this rule: a new Caddy tag still builds with the pinned toolchain image, and digests are refreshed by hand.

packageRules.description: Keep OpenVox Forge updates separate and manually reviewed

Don't let Renovate bump go.mod's own `go` directive - it's pinned to match CI's toolchain (see .github/workflows), and Renovate bumping it alongside an unrelated dependency update breaks the build (seen live 2026-09-08, PR #311: x/sync bump silently carried go 1.25.2 -> 1.26.0)

go.socket.io 0.2.0 makes provision-kuma hang on login against a fresh Kuma 2.5.7 (autosetup), tested 2026-10-24 on a throwaway container; the Kuma client lives in tools/thirdparty and tools/go.mod replaces it, so its version line is never used
